faq.ask: Didn't find an answer? Write to
faq.q1: How is this better than a general AI chat?
faq.a1: A general chat does not keep a catalog of your mistakes. Eduvia keeps every mistake and word, groups them by rule and brings them back in new conversations until you start speaking correctly.
faq.a2: Your first conversation with a level report. Reports, progress, the scenario catalog and the word list are available without a subscription too.
faq.a3: Yes, it is a voice tutor. Microphone access is needed only during conversations.
faq.q4: What level can I start from?
faq.a4: From A1 to C1. The first conversation sets your level, then it grows automatically.
faq.q5: Does it prepare for Goethe or telc?
faq.a5: There is no separate exam mode yet. But you practice the speaking part every day: free conversations and 202 real-life situations.
faq.q6: What languages are the explanations in?
faq.a6: In your interface language: Ukrainian, English, German, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Polish, Romanian, Albanian, Serbian.
faq.q7: How long does a conversation last?
faq.a7: One conversation lasts up to 50 minutes. You can finish any time.
faq.q8: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a8: In your App Store or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting your account does not cancel the subscription.
